# How much of your freelance income goes to self-employment tax?

> Free 2026 self-employment tax calculator for freelancers and sole proprietors: Social Security and Medicare, the $184,500 wage base, W-2 wages, Additional Medicare Tax, and how much of every payment to set aside. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
